title: Every PHP Throwable is an Exception or an Error

ground_truth.statement: Every PHP Throwable is an Exception or an Error. Removing Exception leaves Error and makes the Error return contract sound.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives. This is a behavior comparison, not a recommendation that every precision limitation is product policy. Pinned-tool observations retained without widening expectations: psalm: LessSpecificReturnStatement@6, MoreSpecificReturnType@4; mago: less-specific-return-statement@6. Runtime controls pass. These are measured precision or contract-interpretation disagreements, not assertions that the tool should adopt every tested policy.
